The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `9297` (see `AwsEmulatorBuilder.AwsEmulatorPort`)
- Environment variable: `HOME=/tmp/testcontainers-aws`
- Environment variable: `EMULATOR_TELEMETRY=off`
- Command: `--bind 0.0.0.0 --port 9297 --auth on`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTPS request `GET /__admin/health` to port `9297` is completed successfully.
